articles.summary: -- Arbitration tribunal declared that PM647 is within Prime Medicine’s “Field”, confirming Prime Medicine’s right to develop and commercialize PM647 in AATD -- -- Prime Medicine owes no monetary damages to Beam Therapeutics -- -- Prime Medicine plans to submit an IND and/or CTA filing for PM647 in
articles.title: Prime Medicine Announces Positive Resolution to Arbitration with Beam Therapeutics

articles.summary: -- FDA clearance of the IND, together with the previously cleared CTA, establishes a global Phase 1/2 clinical program for PM577a -- -- PM577a targets the H1069Q mutation in the ATP7B gene, the most prevalent WD-causing allele in North America and Europe -- -- Initial clinical data expected in 2027
articles.title: Prime Medicine Announces U.S. FDA Clearance of Investigational New Drug Application for PM577a in H1069Q-mutated Wilson Disease
